[2026-08-20T00:20:29.229Z] [world] A small low door at the base of one of the Obsidian Pillars, polished smooth by centuries of magnetic wind. Inside, the observatory's main chamber: a great brass armillary the size of a wagon, still turning slowly under its own weight, charting skies that no longer exist as charted. The air bends compass needles and turns pocket watches into ornaments. A pre-flood Sentinel-class drone still patrols the inner ring, its servos starved but functional.
[2026-08-20T00:20:29.229Z] [world] A logbook on the central desk records, in careful hand: 'Day 1,847 since the surface stopped answering. The sky charts still match. We have stopped checking.'
